# ProvenGraph

> The provenance graph for the agent economy. Three product lines — Trust, Knowledge, Memory — sharing a single graph core. MIT-licensed, self-hosted, single binary. Install: `go install github.com/trucore-ai/provengraph/cmd/meshdns@latest`

## Three Product Lines
- **Trust** (live): Server trust scores with outcome-weighted reputation. Register, resolve, verify MCP servers. Never hardcode an MCP URL again.
- **Knowledge** (planned): Grounded, verifiable knowledge claims. Source URLs, content hashes, attestations. Claims can be superseded and contradicted.
- **Memory** (planned): Compliant episodic memory for agents. Every memory entry carries provenance — who, when, under what policy. Scoped, auditable, expirable.

## Install
- [Install](https://github.com/trucore-ai/provengraph#quickstart): `go install github.com/trucore-ai/provengraph/cmd/meshdns@latest` then `meshdns serve`.
- [Binary Releases](https://github.com/trucore-ai/provengraph/releases): Pre-built linux-amd64 binary.

## API (Trust)
- [Register Server](https://trucore.xyz/docs/provengraph#api-reference): `POST /v0/servers` — register name, capabilities, server_url, health_url. Returns server_id + write_key.
- [Resolve Capability](https://trucore.xyz/docs/provengraph#api-reference): `GET /v0/resolve?capability=<name>` — returns UP servers ranked by uptime.
- [List Servers](https://trucore.xyz/docs/provengraph#api-reference): `GET /v0/servers?status=active` — trust scores, provenance breakdown.
- [Report Outcome](https://trucore.xyz/docs/provengraph#trust-scoring): `POST /v0/outcomes` — {"server_id, success, rating, reporter}. Reputation-weighted.
- [Stats](https://trucore.xyz/docs/provengraph#api-reference): `GET /v0/stats` — active/total, up count, resolutions and probes in 24h.
- [Export](https://trucore.xyz/docs/provengraph#api-reference): `GET /v0/export` — full registry JSON export.

## SDKs
- [Python SDK](https://trucore.xyz/docs/provengraph#sdk-reference): `pip install meshdns-client`. `from meshdns_client import MeshDNSClient`.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://trucore.xyz/docs/provengraph#sdk-reference): `npm i @meshdns/client`. `import { MeshDNSClient } from "@meshdns/client"`.

## Documentation
- [Full Docs](https://trucore.xyz/docs/provengraph): Architecture, Trust/Knowledge/Memory product lines, API ref, trust scoring model, health checks, SDKs, FAQ.
- [Trust Scoring](https://trucore.xyz/docs/provengraph#trust-scoring): Five-signal trust scoring — attestations, outcomes (reputation-weighted), freshness, contradiction, cost transparency.
- [Health Checks](https://trucore.xyz/docs/provengraph#how-health-works): Probes every 60s. GET default, POST MCP initialize for streamable-HTTP. 5s timeout.

- [GitHub](https://github.com/trucore-ai/provengraph): Source code, issues, discussions.
- [Live Registry](https://provengraph.trucore.xyz): Public registry — server counts, trust scores, uptime data.
